name: Test Supported Distributions

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  smoke-tests:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 #v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0 # Differential ShellCheck requires full git history

      - name: Check scripts in repository are executable
        run: |
          IFS=$'\n';
          for f in $(find . -name '*.sh' -o -name '*.bats'); do if [[ ! -x $f ]]; then echo "$f is not executable" && FAIL=1; fi ;done
          unset IFS;
          # If FAIL is 1 then we fail.
          [[ $FAIL == 1 ]] && exit 1 || echo "Scripts are executable!"

      - name: Differential ShellCheck
        uses: redhat-plumbers-in-action/differential-shellcheck@f51c7c0d32777d00de777131d25918617a246415 #v5.5.7
        with:
          severity: warning
          display-engine: sarif-fmt

      - name: Secret Scanning with TruffleHog
        uses: trufflesecurity/trufflehog@ea68ca03c865c5f324e86e849ced20ed3cf9dbbb #v3.99.8
        with:
          extra_args: --results=verified,unknown

      - name: Spell-Checking
        uses: codespell-project/actions-codespell@8f01853be192eb0f849a5c7d721450e7a467c579 #v2.2
        with:
          ignore_words_file: .codespellignore

      - name: Get editorconfig-checker
        uses: editorconfig-checker/action-editorconfig-checker@51f63319f592f97930c73d9c46184d20bd206393 #v3.0.0

      - name: Run editorconfig-checker
        run: editorconfig-checker

  distro-test:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: smoke-tests
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        distro:
          [
            debian_12,
            debian_13,
            ubuntu_20,
            ubuntu_22,
            ubuntu_24,
            ubuntu_26,
            centos_9,
            centos_10,
            fedora_40,
            fedora_41,
            fedora_42,
            fedora_43,
            fedora_44,
            fedora_45,
            alpine_3_21,
            alpine_3_22,
            alpine_3_23,
            alpine_3_24,
          ]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 #v7.0.1

      - name: Run BATS test suite for ${{ matrix.distro }}
        run: DISTRO=${{ matrix.distro }} bash test/run.sh

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

Pattern: P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE (failing_schedule_suppression)

When is pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows applicable?

Assess pause repeatedly failing scheduled workflows for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: A monitored pause/resume policy is approved

Contraindications: Continuous monitoring or periodic checks are mandatory

Method: Notify the owner when pausing; Define an explicit recovery and reactivation path

Reported finding: Failure-streak suppression offers estimated savings.

Reported metrics: {"consecutive_failure_threshold": 3, "paid_total_vm_time_reduction_percent": 3.2}
